# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist

1. `_streamAssistantResponse` adds the streamed (partial → final) message into `context.messages` — the partial-first invariant. So when `_retryDegenerateEmpty` re-streams with the same `context`, the FIRST (empty) message is already IN `context.messages`, and the retried message is appended after it. So retried empty messages DO stay in the transcript (as the docstring says — "truthful record").

2. The CLI wires `maxEmptyRetries: 0` so the loop doesn't retry — the CLI handles empty responses with the 'continue' nudge (which is visible in the transcript as a user message).

3. `_settleAfterPrompt` in `agent_cli_run.dart`: if `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply(lastMessage)` → decrement nudge budget, run `_runPrompt('continue', isAutoContinue: true)`.

4. Headless exit-code switch maps `StopReason.error` → 1, `aborted` → 130, else 0.

Now, where should the new behavior live?

**The ticket's architecture:**
- A single classification function `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` with three verdicts: `emptyAfterPartial`, `cleanEmpty`, `abortedOrError`.
- Extend `_isDegenerateEmpty` (loop) and `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply` (CLI) into this classification function.
- Bounded retry policy for `emptyAfterPartial`: N retries (default 3) with exponential backoff, re-streamed through `_streamAssistantResponse`, honoring CancelToken.
- Exhaustion verdict: run error (loud error line naming hiccup, attempt count, last stop reason). Headless → `StopReason.error` → exit 1. Interactive: error line + return to prompt.

Since the CLI handles empty-response retries itself (loop's `maxEmptyRetries: 0` for CLI), the most natural approach for the CLI path:
- In `_settleAfterPrompt`, classify the empty reply:
  - `cleanEmpty` → existing nudge path (unchanged).
  - `emptyAfterPartial` → the bounded retry path: retry by re-prompting (like the nudge, but counted separately, with backoff, and on exhaustion convert the last message into a run error and settle loudly).

Wait, but if we re-prompt via `_runPrompt('continue', ...)`, the transcript gets a "continue" user message and a new empty assistant message. On exhaustion, the last message is the final empty assistant message with `StopReason.stop`. For headless to exit non-zero, `terminalStopReason` (captured from TurnEndEvent) must be `StopReason.error`. The `terminalStopReason` is captured from TurnEndEvent of the actual agent run — the CLI cannot mutate agent state to make it error.

Options for the exhaustion verdict in the CLI:
(a) The retry happens in the agent loop (loop-level): on exhaustion, the loop converts the empty message into a terminal error message (`StopReason.error` + errorMessage). Then `_terminalRunMessages` ends the run with that error message, TurnEndEvent carries `StopReason.error`, headless exits 1, and the CLI's `_onAssistantMessageEnd` prints the error line. This is clean and satisfies AC4/AC5 uniformly. But the CLI sets `maxEmptyRetries: 0`... which would disable the whole thing. Unless we change the CLI wiring to enable the new hiccup retry (the CLI previously wanted "the transcript reflects the retry explicitly" via the continue nudge — but the loop's retries ALSO stay in the transcript since `_streamAssistantResponse` appends the message to context.messages).

Hmm wait — actually, if the loop handles the bounded retry (re-streaming with the same context), the transcript would contain: [user prompt, empty assistant msg, empty assistant msg (retry), ... final]. And the CLI nudge path would only fire for `cleanEmpty`. This actually matches the ticket architecture exactly:

- **Degenerate-empty classifier** — "extend `_isDegenerateEmpty` ... and `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply` ... into a single classification function `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)`".

So both layers consult the SAME classifier:
- The loop: `_retryDegenerateEmpty` uses the classifier — for `emptyAfterPartial`, retry with backoff up to N; on exhaustion, produce the run-error terminal message. For `cleanEmpty` — hmm, does the loop retry `cleanEmpty`? Today the loop retries any degenerate empty up to `maxEmptyRetries` (default 1). The CLI sets 0. The app (host_agent_wiring) defaults to 1.

Let me think about what changes minimally and safely:

**Loop layer (`agent_loop.dart`):**
1. Add `emptyRetryConfig`-ish knobs: reuse `maxEmptyRetries` (rename? No — keep name for compat; ticket says "config key alongside `maxEmptyRetries`"). Hmm: "Bounded retry policy for `emptyAfterPartial` — N retries (default 3, config key alongside `maxEmptyRetries`) with exponential backoff (reuse the `retriesPerEntry`/`baseDelayMs`/`maxBackoffMs` shape from `lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart`)".

So add to `AgentLoopConfig`: e.g. `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3) + backoff shape (baseDelayMs, maxBackoffMs). Let me look at roles_config.dart for the shape.

UT-5 says "content classification — thinking-only + ToolCall → not empty; thinking-only, no text, no tool calls → empty; whitespace-only text → empty". So UT-5 needs a "not empty" outcome. 

I'll define the classifier with a sealed result:

```dart

final class HealthyCompletion extends EmptyCompletionClassification {}  // has text or tool calls

final class EmptyAfterPartialCompletion extends ... { evidence }

Or simpler: an enum with 4 values where the ticket's three verdicts + `notEmpty`. Hmm, but the ticket says "extend ... into a single classification function `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` with three verdicts". The three verdicts are the ones relevant to the empty path. I think an enum `EmptyCompletionVerdict { notEmpty, emptyAfterPartial, cleanEmpty, abortedOrError }` is the pragmatic shape — UT-5 maps to `notEmpty` vs empty variants. Actually, to keep close to the ticket, maybe I return the verdict enum where "not empty" is represented too. Let me just do a sealed class hierarchy? Simpler: enum with a 4th value `notEmpty`. It deviates slightly from the "three verdicts" but is the honest model. Hmm.

Alternatively `classifyEmptyCompletion` returns `EmptyCompletionVerdict?` — null when the message is not empty (has text or tool calls). UT-5 "thinking-only + ToolCall → not empty" would assert null. That's also clean. But nullable enums are less pleasant.

I'll go with an enum of 4: `notEmpty, emptyAfterPartial, cleanEmpty, abortedOrError` and document that the ticket's three verdicts are the empty-path ones. Now I understand the structure well. Key facts:

1. `_streamAssistantResponse` adds the streamed (partial → final) message into `context.messages` — the partial-first invariant. So when `_retryDegenerateEmpty` re-streams with the same `context`, the FIRST (empty) message is already IN `context.messages`, and the retried message is appended after it. So retried empty messages DO stay in the transcript (as the docstring says — "truthful record").

2. The CLI wires `maxEmptyRetries: 0` so the loop doesn't retry — the CLI handles empty responses with the 'continue' nudge (which is visible in the transcript as a user message).

3. `_settleAfterPrompt` in `agent_cli_run.dart`: if `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply(lastMessage)` → decrement nudge budget, run `_runPrompt('continue', isAutoContinue: true)`.

4. Headless exit-code switch maps `StopReason.error` → 1, `aborted` → 130, else 0.

Now, where should the new behavior live?

**The ticket's architecture:**
- A single classification function `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` with three verdicts: `emptyAfterPartial`, `cleanEmpty`, `abortedOrError`.
- Extend `_isDegenerateEmpty` (loop) and `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply` (CLI) into this classification function.
- Bounded retry policy for `emptyAfterPartial`: N retries (default 3) with exponential backoff, re-streamed through `_streamAssistantResponse`, honoring CancelToken.
- Exhaustion verdict: run error (loud error line naming hiccup, attempt count, last stop reason). Headless → `StopReason.error` → exit 1. Interactive: error line + return to prompt.

Since the CLI handles empty-response retries itself (loop's `maxEmptyRetries: 0` for CLI), the most natural approach for the CLI path:

1. **Degenerate-empty classifier** — a single classification function `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` with three verdicts:

10 memories found:
project: (note) Headless full-boot TUI tests (AgentCli with useTui: true) MUST pass `tuiProgramHooks: TuiProgramHooks(input: keys.stream, output: frames, width:, height:)` in AgentCliConfig — without it the dart_tui program writes to FakeCliIO's stdout and the _FrameSink stays empty forever, so every frames.text waitFor spins to timeout. Working twins: agent_hub_overlay_guard_test.dart, agent_cli_tui_sync_test.dart. Also anchor any injected waitingClock at DateTime.now(), never a pinned past date (overdue-timer storm starves the REPL loop). [#note,#source_agent,testing,tui,integration-test,gotcha]
project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. Budget arithmetic for GH Actions: attempts*max_time + (attempts-1)*sleep must fit the step's timeout-minutes (remember curl `--retry N` means N retries PLUS the initial attempt). [#note,#source_agent,ci,github-actions,curl,networking,workflows,gotcha]
project: (note) fa app-suite repair round (all under main checkout, ungated-clone-era debts): the flutter_app suite had 14 red tests+guards, ALL from other agents' hook-skipped commits — fixed in 0.1.239: (1) agent_service compaction-failure test expected 'transcript untouched' but the emergency _localTrimFallback (0.1.219, deliberate) honestly trims in-memory with a '[context trimmed locally…' marker while the session file keeps every record — test now asserts the marker + full records on disk; (2) session_chat_sheet drawer tests: FlutterSessionManager.openSession completes only over REAL async hops (widget-test fake clock doesn't advance it) — bounded drain loop `for(i<50 && activeId!=target) { await tester.runAsync(() => Future.delayed(10ms)); await pumpAndSettle(); }` after the tap; (3) map goldens: commit 4ea43d4e slimmed the bundle (map demo → fa_widgets catalog) — mapGolden + the controls-menu test now markTestSkipped when assets/apps/map/manifest.json is absent; (4) cli_visual ctrl+s test: shell-job ids are now sh-<n>-<uniq> — parse RegExp 'sh-[A-Za-z0-9-]+' from the /tasks screen and cancel the exact id (bare 'sh-1' → 'unknown job'); (5) cli_visual /agents inbox test: sessions live under <home>/Library/Group Containers/group.dev.fa1.shared/fa/sessions (macOS default, bin/fah.dart _defaultSessionRoot prefers it when writable) — seed mail by searching both roots; (6) session_reuse: aa770722 made corrupt JSONL lines QUARANTINED (dropped + .corrupt sidecar), not fatal — test updated to 'loads with junk quarantined'; (7) WidgetsCatalogSheet failed golden_guard (no golden) + l10n_guard ('Install failed: $error', 'Retry'×2 hardcoded) — added widgetsCatalogInstallFailed/Offline/LoadFailed/Retry keys (en+ru), context.l10n routing (import l10n_ext.dart!), new test/golden/widgets_catalog_golden_test.dart (MockClient catalog, pumpGolden+expectGolden, 420x700 in goldenSizeTall) registered in golden_guard _coverage; gen-l10n regenerates app_localizations*.dart. Regenerated goldens MUST be eyeballed (apps_grid.png = 15 demo tiles, clean). Full app suite: 1356 passed / 44 skipped / 0 failed. [#note,#source_agent,fa,app-tests,golden,l10n,guards]
project: (note) fa 0.1.240 shipped (commit 0dc54496 on origin/main, installed): compaction-hang fix. Root cause of the ~58-min 'Compacting context…' spinner: a summarizer endpoint that accepts the request and never answers pends stream.result forever — provider connect/idle watchdogs (180s/5min) miss dribbling keep-alives and lost completions. Fix: AutoCompactor gained attemptBudget (default 10 min, ctor param) — every compactSession() attempt runs under Future.timeout; TimeoutException is non-transient (no retry spin), the pass falls to the next summarizer or the honest local trim, turn continues. Bonus fix found by the new test: the emergency local trim now zeroes kept AssistantMessage usage anchors (a stale generation-time anchor kept the post-trim estimate over the window and retriggered compaction every turn — same rule as the success pass). Two tests with a never-completing Completer summarizer drive both paths (rescue-via-trim, honest-failure-when-nothing-to-trim). Note: user's live hung session needs kill + `fa --session <id>` resume; new fa prevents recurrence. Push needed rebase (other agents pushed chore(release): v0.1.240 — landed cleanly). [#note,#source_agent,fa,compaction,hang,0.1.240]
project: (note) Google adapter now retries once on exact 400 'Unable to process input image' error by replacing inlineData images with text placeholder '(image omitted: the model backend could not decode it)' — allows agent to gracefully handle corrupt images [#note,#source_agent,400-error,image-placeholder,retry]
project: (note) Bundled demo apps were removed from the app bundle entirely; the catalog is now the only source of widgets and Reset apps returns an empty grid. [#note,#source_agent,demos,reset,catalog-only]
project: (note) CPU-шторм fa: корень — overflow в HubClient.defaultBackoff (`1 << (attempt-1)` даёт ноль с attempt 65+), вызывая вечный tight-loop реконнектов к несуществующему хабу ws://127.0.0.1:8787; фикс — clamp до сдвига, регрессионный тест test/backoff_overflow_test.dart. [#note,#source_agent,bugfix,fah_hub_client]
project: (note) In the vendored dart_tui, early renders must drop the frame and defer a single RenderTickMsg (Bubbletea-style) instead of sleeping the event loop — the old Future.delayed frame-budget sleep blocked input handling and caused keyboard jitter. [#note,#source_agent,tui,input-latency,rendering]
project: (note) CodeMie with a dead SSO session silently 302-redirects to the login portal; both fetch and dart:io follow the redirect, so API calls return 200+text/html (or 200+JSON gateway error, or an empty event-stream) — sendProviderRequest in provider_common.dart rejects all three and emits the [[auth-expired:codemie]] marker. 10 memories found:
project: (note) Headless full-boot TUI tests (AgentCli with useTui: true) MUST pass `tuiProgramHooks: TuiProgramHooks(input: keys.stream, output: frames, width:, height:)` in AgentCliConfig — without it the dart_tui program writes to FakeCliIO's stdout and the _FrameSink stays empty forever, so every frames.text waitFor spins to timeout. Working twins: agent_hub_overlay_guard_test.dart, agent_cli_tui_sync_test.dart. Also anchor any injected waitingClock at DateTime.now(), never a pinned past date (overdue-timer storm starves the REPL loop). [#note,#source_agent,testing,tui,integration-test,gotcha]
project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. Budget arithmetic for GH Actions: attempts*max_time + (attempts-1)*sleep must fit the step's timeout-minutes (remember curl `--retry N` means N retries PLUS the initial attempt). [#note,#source_agent,ci,github-actions,curl,networking,workflows,gotcha]
project: (note) fa app-suite repair round (all under main checkout, ungated-clone-era debts): the flutter_app suite had 14 red tests+guards, ALL from other agents' hook-skipped commits — fixed in 0.1.239: (1) agent_service compaction-failure test expected 'transcript untouched' but the emergency _localTrimFallback (0.1.219, deliberate) honestly trims in-memory with a '[context trimmed locally…' marker while the session file keeps every record — test now asserts the marker + full records on disk; (2) session_chat_sheet drawer tests: FlutterSessionManager.openSession completes only over REAL async hops (widget-test fake clock doesn't advance it) — bounded drain loop `for(i<50 && activeId!=target) { await tester.runAsync(() => Future.delayed(10ms)); await pumpAndSettle(); }` after the tap; (3) map goldens: commit 4ea43d4e slimmed the bundle (map demo → fa_widgets catalog) — mapGolden + the controls-menu test now markTestSkipped when assets/apps/map/manifest.json is absent; (4) cli_visual ctrl+s test: shell-job ids are now sh-<n>-<uniq> — parse RegExp 'sh-[A-Za-z0-9-]+' from the /tasks screen and cancel the exact id (bare 'sh-1' → 'unknown job'); (5) cli_visual /agents inbox test: sessions live under <home>/Library/Group Containers/group.dev.fa1.shared/fa/sessions (macOS default, bin/fah.dart _defaultSessionRoot prefers it when writable) — seed mail by searching both roots; (6) session_reuse: aa770722 made corrupt JSONL lines QUARANTINED (dropped + .corrupt sidecar), not fatal — test updated to 'loads with junk quarantined'; (7) WidgetsCatalogSheet failed golden_guard (no golden) + l10n_guard ('Install failed: $error', 'Retry'×2 hardcoded) — added widgetsCatalogInstallFailed/Offline/LoadFailed/Retry keys (en+ru), context.l10n routing (import l10n_ext.dart!), new test/golden/widgets_catalog_golden_test.dart (MockClient catalog, pumpGolden+expectGolden, 420x700 in goldenSizeTall) registered in golden_guard _coverage; gen-l10n regenerates app_localizations*.dart. project: (note) fa 0.1.240 shipped (commit 0dc54496 on origin/main, installed): compaction-hang fix. Root cause of the ~58-min 'Compacting context…' spinner: a summarizer endpoint that accepts the request and never answers pends stream.result forever — provider connect/idle watchdogs (180s/5min) miss dribbling keep-alives and lost completions. Fix: AutoCompactor gained attemptBudget (default 10 min, ctor param) — every compactSession() attempt runs under Future.timeout; TimeoutException is non-transient (no retry spin), the pass falls to the next summarizer or the honest local trim, turn continues. Bonus fix found by the new test: the emergency local trim now zeroes kept AssistantMessage usage anchors (a stale generation-time anchor kept the post-trim estimate over the window and retriggered compaction every turn — same rule as the success pass). Two tests with a never-completing Completer summarizer drive both paths (rescue-via-trim, honest-failure-when-nothing-to-trim). Note: user's live hung session needs kill + `fa --session <id>` resume; new fa prevents recurrence. Push needed rebase (other agents pushed chore(release): v0.1.240 — landed cleanly). [#note,#source_agent,fa,compaction,hang,0.1.240]

Now I understand the structure well. Key facts:

1. `_streamAssistantResponse` adds the streamed (partial → final) message into `context.messages` — the partial-first invariant. So when `_retryDegenerateEmpty` re-streams with the same `context`, the FIRST (empty) message is already IN `context.messages`, and the retried message is appended after it. So retried empty messages DO stay in the transcript (as the docstring says — "truthful record").

2. The CLI wires `maxEmptyRetries: 0` so the loop doesn't retry — the CLI handles empty responses with the 'continue' nudge (which is visible in the transcript as a user message).

3. `_settleAfterPrompt` in `agent_cli_run.dart`: if `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply(lastMessage)` → decrement nudge budget, run `_runPrompt('continue', isAutoContinue: true)`.

4. Headless exit-code switch maps `StopReason.error` → 1, `aborted` → 130, else 0.

Now, where should the new behavior live?

**The ticket's architecture:**
- A single classification function `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` with three verdicts: `emptyAfterPartial`, `cleanEmpty`, `abortedOrError`.
- Extend `_isDegenerateEmpty` (loop) and `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply` (CLI) into this classification function.
- Bounded retry policy for `emptyAfterPartial`: N retries (default 3) with exponential backoff, re-streamed through `_streamAssistantResponse`, honoring CancelToken.
- Exhaustion verdict: run error (loud error line naming hiccup, attempt count, last stop reason). Headless → `StopReason.error` → exit 1. Interactive: error line + return to prompt.

Since the CLI handles empty-response retries itself (loop's `maxEmptyRetries: 0` for CLI), the most natural approach for the CLI path:
- In `_settleAfterPrompt`, classify the empty reply:
  - `cleanEmpty` → existing nudge path (unchanged).
  - `emptyAfterPartial` → the bounded retry path: retry by re-prompting (like the nudge, but counted separately, with backoff, and on exhaustion convert the last message into a run error and settle loudly).

Wait, but if we re-prompt via `_runPrompt('continue', ...)`, the transcript gets a "continue" user message and a new empty assistant message. On exhaustion, the last message is the final empty assistant message with `StopReason.stop`. For headless to exit non-zero, `terminalStopReason` (captured from TurnEndEvent) must be `StopReason.error`. The `terminalStopReason` is captured from TurnEndEvent of the actual agent run — the CLI cannot mutate agent state to make it error.

Options for the exhaustion verdict in the CLI:
(a) The retry happens in the agent loop (loop-level): on exhaustion, the loop converts the empty message into a terminal error message (`StopReason.error` + errorMessage). Then `_terminalRunMessages` ends the run with that error message, TurnEndEvent carries `StopReason.error`, headless exits 1, and the CLI's `_onAssistantMessageEnd` prints the error line. This is clean and satisfies AC4/AC5 uniformly. But the CLI sets `maxEmptyRetries: 0`... which would disable the whole thing. Unless we change the CLI wiring to enable the new hiccup retry (the CLI previously wanted "the transcript reflects the retry explicitly" via the continue nudge — but the loop's retries ALSO stay in the transcript since `_streamAssistantResponse` appends the message to context.messages).

Hmm wait — actually, if the loop handles the bounded retry (re-streaming with the same context), the transcript would contain: [user prompt, empty assistant msg, empty assistant msg (retry), ... final]. And the CLI nudge path would only fire for `cleanEmpty`. This actually matches the ticket architecture exactly:

- **Degenerate-empty classifier** — "extend `_isDegenerateEmpty` ... and `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply` ... into a single classification function `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)`".

So both layers consult the SAME classifier:
- The loop: `_retryDegenerateEmpty` uses the classifier — for `emptyAfterPartial`, retry with backoff up to N; on exhaustion, produce the run-error terminal message. For `cleanEmpty` — hmm, does the loop retry `cleanEmpty`? Today the loop retries any degenerate empty up to `maxEmptyRetries` (default 1). The CLI sets 0. The app (host_agent_wiring) defaults to 1.

Let me think about what changes minimally and safely:

**Loop layer (`agent_loop.dart`):**
1. Add `emptyRetryConfig`-ish knobs: reuse `maxEmptyRetries` (rename? No — keep name for compat; ticket says "config key alongside `maxEmptyRetries`"). Hmm: "Bounded retry policy for `emptyAfterPartial` — N retries (default 3, config key alongside `maxEmptyRetries`) with exponential backoff (reuse the `retriesPerEntry`/`baseDelayMs`/`maxBackoffMs` shape from `lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart`)".

So add to `AgentLoopConfig`: e.g. `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3) + backoff shape (baseDelayMs, maxBackoffMs). Let me look at roles_config.dart for the shape.

UT-5 says "content classification — thinking-only + ToolCall → not empty; thinking-only, no text, no tool calls → empty; whitespace-only text → empty". So UT-5 needs a "not empty" outcome.

final class HealthyCompletion extends EmptyCompletionClassification {}  // has text or tool calls

Hmm, but the ticket says "extend ... into a single classification function `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` with three verdicts". The three verdicts are the ones relevant to the empty path. I think an enum `EmptyCompletionVerdict { notEmpty, emptyAfterPartial, cleanEmpty, abortedOrError }` is the pragmatic shape — UT-5 maps to `notEmpty` vs empty variants. Actually, to keep close to the ticket, maybe I return the verdict enum where "not empty" is represented too. Let me just do a sealed class hierarchy? Simpler: enum with a 4th value `notEmpty`. It deviates slightly from the "three verdicts" but is the honest model. Hmm.

project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. Budget arithmetic for GH Actions: attempts*max_time + (attempts-1)*sleep must fit the step's timeout-minutes (remember curl `--retry N` means N retries PLUS the initial attempt). Now I understand the structure well. Key facts:

1. `_streamAssistantResponse` adds the streamed (partial → final) message into `context.messages` — the partial-first invariant. So when `_retryDegenerateEmpty` re-streams with the same `context`, the FIRST (empty) message is already IN `context.messages`, and the retried message is appended after it. So retried empty messages DO stay in the transcript (as the docstring says — "truthful record").

2. The CLI wires `maxEmptyRetries: 0` so the loop doesn't retry — the CLI handles empty responses with the 'continue' nudge (which is visible in the transcript as a user message).

3. `_settleAfterPrompt` in `agent_cli_run.dart`: if `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply(lastMessage)` → decrement nudge budget, run `_runPrompt('continue', isAutoContinue: true)`.

4. Headless exit-code switch maps `StopReason.error` → 1, `aborted` → 130, else 0.

Now, where should the new behavior live?

**The ticket's architecture:**
- A single classification function `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` with three verdicts: `emptyAfterPartial`, `cleanEmpty`, `abortedOrError`.
- Extend `_isDegenerateEmpty` (loop) and `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply` (CLI) into this classification function.
- Bounded retry policy for `emptyAfterPartial`: N retries (default 3) with exponential backoff, re-streamed through `_streamAssistantResponse`, honoring CancelToken.
- Exhaustion verdict: run error (loud error line naming hiccup, attempt count, last stop reason). Headless → `StopReason.error` → exit 1. Interactive: error line + return to prompt.

Since the CLI handles empty-response retries itself (loop's `maxEmptyRetries: 0` for CLI), the most natural approach for the CLI path:
- In `_settleAfterPrompt`, classify the empty reply:
  - `cleanEmpty` → existing nudge path (unchanged).
  - `emptyAfterPartial` → the bounded retry path: retry by re-prompting (like the nudge, but counted separately, with backoff, and on exhaustion convert the last message into a run error and settle loudly).

Wait, but if we re-prompt via `_runPrompt('continue', ...)`, the transcript gets a "continue" user message and a new empty assistant message. On exhaustion, the last message is the final empty assistant message with `StopReason.stop`. For headless to exit non-zero, `terminalStopReason` (captured from TurnEndEvent) must be `StopReason.error`. The `terminalStopReason` is captured from TurnEndEvent of the actual agent run — the CLI cannot mutate agent state to make it error.

Options for the exhaustion verdict in the CLI:
(a) The retry happens in the agent loop (loop-level): on exhaustion, the loop converts the empty message into a terminal error message (`StopReason.error` + errorMessage). Then `_terminalRunMessages` ends the run with that error message, TurnEndEvent carries `StopReason.error`, headless exits 1, and the CLI's `_onAssistantMessageEnd` prints the error line. This is clean and satisfies AC4/AC5 uniformly. But the CLI sets `maxEmptyRetries: 0`... which would disable the whole thing. Unless we change the CLI wiring to enable the new hiccup retry (the CLI previously wanted "the transcript reflects the retry explicitly" via the continue nudge — but the loop's retries ALSO stay in the transcript since `_streamAssistantResponse` appends the message to context.messages).

Hmm wait — actually, if the loop handles the bounded retry (re-streaming with the same context), the transcript would contain: [user prompt, empty assistant msg, empty assistant msg (retry), ... final]. And the CLI nudge path would only fire for `cleanEmpty`. This actually matches the ticket architecture exactly:

- **Degenerate-empty classifier** — "extend `_isDegenerateEmpty` ... and `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply` ... into a single classification function `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)`".

So both layers consult the SAME classifier:
- The loop: `_retryDegenerateEmpty` uses the classifier — for `emptyAfterPartial`, retry with backoff up to N; on exhaustion, produce the run-error terminal message. For `cleanEmpty` — hmm, does the loop retry `cleanEmpty`? Today the loop retries any degenerate empty up to `maxEmptyRetries` (default 1). The CLI sets 0. The app (host_agent_wiring) defaults to 1.

Let me think about what changes minimally and safely:

**Loop layer (`agent_loop.dart`):**
1. Add `emptyRetryConfig`-ish knobs: reuse `maxEmptyRetries` (rename? No — keep name for compat; ticket says "config key alongside `maxEmptyRetries`"). Hmm: "Bounded retry policy for `emptyAfterPartial` — N retries (default 3, config key alongside `maxEmptyRetries`) with exponential backoff (reuse the `retriesPerEntry`/`baseDelayMs`/`maxBackoffMs` shape from `lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart`)".

So add to `AgentLoopConfig`: e.g. `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3) + backoff shape (baseDelayMs, maxBackoffMs). Let me look at roles_config.dart for the shape.

The three verdicts are the ones relevant to the empty path. I think an enum `EmptyCompletionVerdict { notEmpty, emptyAfterPartial, cleanEmpty, abortedOrError }` is the pragmatic shape — UT-5 maps to `notEmpty` vs empty variants. Actually, to keep close to the ticket, maybe I return the verdict enum where "not empty" is represented too. Let me just do a sealed class hierarchy? Simpler: enum with a 4th value `notEmpty`. It deviates slightly from the "three verdicts" but is the honest model. Hmm.

blocks.text:
Now I understand the structure well. Key facts:

1. `_streamAssistantResponse` adds the streamed (partial → final) message into `context.messages` — the partial-first invariant. So when `_retryDegenerateEmpty` re-streams with the same `context`, the FIRST (empty) message is already IN `context.messages`, and the retried message is appended after it. So retried empty messages DO stay in the transcript (as the docstring says — "truthful record").

2. The CLI wires `maxEmptyRetries: 0` so the loop doesn't retry — the CLI handles empty responses with the 'continue' nudge (which is visible in the transcript as a user message).

3. `_settleAfterPrompt` in `agent_cli_run.dart`: if `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply(lastMessage)` → decrement nudge budget, run `_runPrompt('continue', isAutoContinue: true)`.

4. Headless exit-code switch maps `StopReason.error` → 1, `aborted` → 130, else 0.

Now, where should the new behavior live?

**The ticket's architecture:**
- A single classification function `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` with three verdicts: `emptyAfterPartial`, `cleanEmpty`, `abortedOrError`.
- Extend `_isDegenerateEmpty` (loop) and `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply` (CLI) into this classification function.
- Bounded retry policy for `emptyAfterPartial`: N retries (default 3) with exponential backoff, re-streamed through `_streamAssistantResponse`, honoring CancelToken.
- Exhaustion verdict: run error (loud error line naming hiccup, attempt count, last stop reason). Headless → `StopReason.error` → exit 1. Interactive: error line + return to prompt.

Since the CLI handles empty-response retries itself (loop's `maxEmptyRetries: 0` for CLI), the most natural approach for the CLI path:
- In `_settleAfterPrompt`, classify the empty reply:
  - `cleanEmpty` → existing nudge path (unchanged).

blocks.text:
Now I understand the structure well. Key facts:

1. `_streamAssistantResponse` adds the streamed (partial → final) message into `context.messages` — the partial-first invariant. So when `_retryDegenerateEmpty` re-streams with the same `context`, the FIRST (empty) message is already IN `context.messages`, and the retried message is appended after it. So retried empty messages DO stay in the transcript (as the docstring says — "truthful record").

2. The CLI wires `maxEmptyRetries: 0` so the loop doesn't retry — the CLI handles empty responses with the 'continue' nudge (which is visible in the transcript as a user message).

3. `_settleAfterPrompt` in `agent_cli_run.dart`: if `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply(lastMessage)` → decrement nudge budget, run `_runPrompt('continue', isAutoContinue: true)`.

4. Headless exit-code switch maps `StopReason.error` → 1, `aborted` → 130, else 0.

Now, where should the new behavior live?

**The ticket's architecture:**
- A single classification function `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` with three verdicts: `emptyAfterPartial`, `cleanEmpty`, `abortedOrError`.
- Extend `_isDegenerateEmpty` (loop) and `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply` (CLI) into this classification function.
- Bounded retry policy for `emptyAfterPartial`: N retries (default 3) with exponential backoff, re-streamed through `_streamAssistantResponse`, honoring CancelToken.
- Exhaustion verdict: run error (loud error line naming hiccup, attempt count, last stop reason). Headless → `StopReason.error` → exit 1. Interactive: error line + return to prompt.

Since the CLI handles empty-response retries itself (loop's `maxEmptyRetries: 0` for CLI), the most natural approach for the CLI path:
- In `_settleAfterPrompt`, classify the empty reply:
  - `cleanEmpty` → existing nudge path (unchanged).
  - `emptyAfterPartial` → the bounded retry path: retry by re-prompting (like the nudge, but counted separately, with backoff, and on exhaustion convert the last message into a run error and settle loudly).

Wait, but if we re-prompt via `_runPrompt('continue', ...)`, the transcript gets a "continue" user message and a new empty assistant message. On exhaustion, the last message is the final empty assistant message with `StopReason.stop`. For headless to exit non-zero, `terminalStopReason` (captured from TurnEndEvent) must be `StopReason.error`. The `terminalStopReason` is captured from TurnEndEvent of the actual agent run — the CLI cannot mutate agent state to make it error.

Options for the exhaustion verdict in the CLI:
(a) The retry happens in the agent loop (loop-level): on exhaustion, the loop converts the empty message into a terminal error message (`StopReason.error` + errorMessage). Then `_terminalRunMessages` ends the run with that error message, TurnEndEvent carries `StopReason.error`, headless exits 1, and the CLI's `_onAssistantMessageEnd` prints the error line. This is clean and satisfies AC4/AC5 uniformly. But the CLI sets `maxEmptyRetries: 0`... which would disable the whole thing. Unless we change the CLI wiring to enable the new hiccup retry (the CLI previously wanted "the transcript reflects the retry explicitly" via the continue nudge — but the loop's retries ALSO stay in the transcript since `_streamAssistantResponse` appends the message to context.messages).

Hmm wait — actually, if the loop handles the bounded retry (re-streaming with the same context), the transcript would contain: [user prompt, empty assistant msg, empty assistant msg (retry), ... final]. And the CLI nudge path would only fire for `cleanEmpty`. This actually matches the ticket architecture exactly:

- **Degenerate-empty classifier** — "extend `_isDegenerateEmpty` ... and `_shouldContinueAfterEmptyReply` ... into a single classification function `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)`".

So both layers consult the SAME classifier:
- The loop: `_retryDegenerateEmpty` uses the classifier — for `emptyAfterPartial`, retry with backoff up to N; on exhaustion, produce the run-error terminal message. For `cleanEmpty` — hmm, does the loop retry `cleanEmpty`? Today the loop retries any degenerate empty up to `maxEmptyRetries` (default 1). The CLI sets 0. The app (host_agent_wiring) defaults to 1.

Let me think about what changes minimally and safely:

**Loop layer (`agent_loop.dart`):**
1. Add `emptyRetryConfig`-ish knobs: reuse `maxEmptyRetries` (rename? No — keep name for compat; ticket says "config key alongside `maxEmptyRetries`"). Hmm: "Bounded retry policy for `emptyAfterPartial` — N retries (default 3, config key alongside `maxEmptyRetries`) with exponential backoff (reuse the `retriesPerEntry`/`baseDelayMs`/`maxBackoffMs` shape from `lib/src/model_roles/roles_config.dart`)".

So add to `AgentLoopConfig`: e.g. `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3) + backoff shape (baseDelayMs, maxBackoffMs). Let me look at roles_config.dart for the shape.

2. Classification function `classifyEmptyCompletion(turnHistory, message)` — pure, exported (tests UT-1..UT-5 are pure). Verdicts:
   - `abortedOrError`: stopReason aborted/error (guard first).

project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. Budget arithmetic for GH Actions: attempts*max_time + (attempts-1)*sleep must fit the step's timeout-minutes (remember curl `--retry N` means N retries PLUS the initial attempt). project: (note) Headless full-boot TUI tests (AgentCli with useTui: true) MUST pass `tuiProgramHooks: TuiProgramHooks(input: keys.stream, output: frames, width:, height:)` in AgentCliConfig — without it the dart_tui program writes to FakeCliIO's stdout and the _FrameSink stays empty forever, so every frames.text waitFor spins to timeout. Also anchor any injected waitingClock at DateTime.now(), never a pinned past date (overdue-timer storm starves the REPL loop). [#note,#source_agent,testing,tui,integration-test,gotcha]
project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. Budget arithmetic for GH Actions: attempts*max_time + (attempts-1)*sleep must fit the step's timeout-minutes (remember curl `--retry N` means N retries PLUS the initial attempt). [#note,#source_agent,ci,github-actions,curl,networking,workflows,gotcha]
project: (note) fa app-suite repair round (all under main checkout, ungated-clone-era debts): the flutter_app suite had 14 red tests+guards, ALL from other agents' hook-skipped commits — fixed in 0.1.239: (1) agent_service compaction-failure test expected 'transcript untouched' but the emergency _localTrimFallback (0.1.219, deliberate) honestly trims in-memory with a '[context trimmed locally…' marker while the session file keeps every record — test now asserts the marker + full records on disk; (2) session_chat_sheet drawer tests: FlutterSessionManager.openSession completes only over REAL async hops (widget-test fake clock doesn't advance it) — bounded drain loop `for(i<50 && activeId!=target) { await tester.runAsync(() => Future.delayed(10ms)); await pumpAndSettle(); }` after the tap; (3) map goldens: commit 4ea43d4e slimmed the bundle (map demo → fa_widgets catalog) — mapGolden + the controls-menu test now markTestSkipped when assets/apps/map/manifest.json is absent; (4) cli_visual ctrl+s test: shell-job ids are now sh-<n>-<uniq> — parse RegExp 'sh-[A-Za-z0-9-]+' from the /tasks screen and cancel the exact id (bare 'sh-1' → 'unknown job'); (5) cli_visual /agents inbox test: sessions live under <home>/Library/Group Containers/group.dev.fa1.shared/fa/sessions (macOS default, bin/fah.dart _defaultSessionRoot prefers it when writable) — seed mail by searching both roots; (6) session_reuse: aa770722 made corrupt JSONL lines QUARANTINED (dropped + .corrupt sidecar), not fatal — test updated to 'loads with junk quarantined'; (7) WidgetsCatalogSheet failed golden_guard (no golden) + l10n_guard ('Install failed: $error', 'Retry'×2 hardcoded) — added widgetsCatalogInstallFailed/Offline/LoadFailed/Retry keys (en+ru), context.l10n routing (import l10n_ext.dart!), new test/golden/widgets_catalog_golden_test.dart (MockClient catalog, pumpGolden+expectGolden, 420x700 in goldenSizeTall) registered in golden_guard _coverage; gen-l10n regenerates app_localizations*.dart. project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. Budget arithmetic for GH Actions: attempts*max_time + (attempts-1)*sleep must fit the step's timeout-minutes (remember curl `--retry N` means N retries PLUS the initial attempt). project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. Budget arithmetic for GH Actions: attempts*max_time + (attempts-1)*sleep must fit the step's timeout-minutes (remember curl `--retry N` means N retries PLUS the initial attempt). project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. Budget arithmetic for GH Actions: attempts*max_time + (attempts-1)*sleep must fit the step's timeout-minutes (remember curl `--retry N` means N retries PLUS the initial attempt). project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. Budget arithmetic for GH Actions: attempts*max_time + (attempts-1)*sleep must fit the step's timeout-minutes (remember curl `--retry N` means N retries PLUS the initial attempt). project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. Budget arithmetic for GH Actions: attempts*max_time + (attempts-1)*sleep must fit the step's timeout-minutes (remember curl `--retry N` means N retries PLUS the initial attempt). project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. Budget arithmetic for GH Actions: attempts*max_time + (attempts-1)*sleep must fit the step's timeout-minutes (remember curl `--retry N` means N retries PLUS the initial attempt). project: (note) Headless full-boot TUI tests (AgentCli with useTui: true) MUST pass `tuiProgramHooks: TuiProgramHooks(input: keys.stream, output: frames, width:, height:)` in AgentCliConfig — without it the dart_tui program writes to FakeCliIO's stdout and the _FrameSink stays empty forever, so every frames.text waitFor spins to timeout. Working twins: agent_hub_overlay_guard_test.dart, agent_cli_tui_sync_test.dart. Also anchor any injected waitingClock at DateTime.now(), never a pinned past date (overdue-timer storm starves the REPL loop). [#note,#source_agent,testing,tui,integration-test,gotcha]
project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. Budget arithmetic for GH Actions: attempts*max_time + (attempts-1)*sleep must fit the step's timeout-minutes (remember curl `--retry N` means N retries PLUS the initial attempt). [#note,#source_agent,ci,github-actions,curl,networking,workflows,gotcha]
project: (note) fa app-suite repair round (all under main checkout, ungated-clone-era debts): the flutter_app suite had 14 red tests+guards, ALL from other agents' hook-skipped commits — fixed in 0.1.239: (1) agent_service compaction-failure test expected 'transcript untouched' but the emergency _localTrimFallback (0.1.219, deliberate) honestly trims in-memory with a '[context trimmed locally…' marker while the session file keeps every record — test now asserts the marker + full records on disk; (2) session_chat_sheet drawer tests: FlutterSessionManager.openSession completes only over REAL async hops (widget-test fake clock doesn't advance it) — bounded drain loop `for(i<50 && activeId!=target) { await tester.runAsync(() => Future.delayed(10ms)); await pumpAndSettle(); }` after the tap; (3) map goldens: commit 4ea43d4e slimmed the bundle (map demo → fa_widgets catalog) — mapGolden + the controls-menu test now markTestSkipped when assets/apps/map/manifest.json is absent; (4) cli_visual ctrl+s test: shell-job ids are now sh-<n>-<uniq> — parse RegExp 'sh-[A-Za-z0-9-]+' from the /tasks screen and cancel the exact id (bare 'sh-1' → 'unknown job'); (5) cli_visual /agents inbox test: sessions live under <home>/Library/Group Containers/group.dev.fa1.shared/fa/sessions (macOS default, bin/fah.dart _defaultSessionRoot prefers it when writable) — seed mail by searching both roots; (6) session_reuse: aa770722 made corrupt JSONL lines QUARANTINED (dropped + .corrupt sidecar), not fatal — test updated to 'loads with junk quarantined'; (7) WidgetsCatalogSheet failed golden_guard (no golden) + l10n_guard ('Install failed: $error', 'Retry'×2 hardcoded) — added widgetsCatalogInstallFailed/Offline/LoadFailed/Retry keys (en+ru), context.l10n routing (import l10n_ext.dart!), new test/golden/widgets_catalog_golden_test.dart (MockClient catalog, pumpGolden+expectGolden, 420x700 in goldenSizeTall) registered in golden_guard _coverage; gen-l10n regenerates app_localizations*.dart. Regenerated goldens MUST be eyeballed (apps_grid.png = 15 demo tiles, clean). Full app suite: 1356 passed / 44 skipped / 0 failed. [#note,#source_agent,fa,app-tests,golden,l10n,guards]
project: (note) fa 0.1.240 shipped (commit 0dc54496 on origin/main, installed): compaction-hang fix. Root cause of the ~58-min 'Compacting context…' spinner: a summarizer endpoint that accepts the request and never answers pends stream.result forever — provider connect/idle watchdogs (180s/5min) miss dribbling keep-alives and lost completions. Fix: AutoCompactor gained attemptBudget (default 10 min, ctor param) — every compactSession() attempt runs under Future.timeout; TimeoutException is non-transient (no retry spin), the pass falls to the next summarizer or the honest local trim, turn continues. Bonus fix found by the new test: the emergency local trim now zeroes kept AssistantMessage usage anchors (a stale generation-time anchor kept the post-trim estimate over the window and retriggered compaction every turn — same rule as the success pass). Two tests with a never-completing Completer summarizer drive both paths (rescue-via-trim, honest-failure-when-nothing-to-trim). Note: user's live hung session needs kill + `fa --session <id>` resume; new fa prevents recurrence. Push needed rebase (other agents pushed chore(release): v0.1.240 — landed cleanly). [#note,#source_agent,fa,compaction,hang,0.1.240]
project: (note) Google adapter now retries once on exact 400 'Unable to process input image' error by replacing inlineData images with text placeholder '(image omitted: the model backend could not decode it)' — allows agent to gracefully handle corrupt images [#note,#source_agent,400-error,image-placeholder,retry]
project: (note) Bundled demo apps were removed from the app bundle entirely; the catalog is now the only source of widgets and Reset apps returns an empty grid. [#note,#source_agent,demos,reset,catalog-only]
project: (note) CPU-шторм fa: корень — overflow в HubClient.defaultBackoff (`1 << (attempt-1)` даёт ноль с attempt 65+), вызывая вечный tight-loop реконнектов к несуществующему хабу ws://127.0.0.1:8787; фикс — clamp до сдвига, регрессионный тест test/backoff_overflow_test.dart. [#note,#source_agent,bugfix,fah_hub_client]
project: (note) In the vendored dart_tui, early renders must drop the frame and defer a single RenderTickMsg (Bubbletea-style) instead of sleeping the event loop — the old Future.delayed frame-budget sleep blocked input handling and caused keyboard jitter. [#note,#source_agent,tui,input-latency,rendering]
project: (note) CodeMie with a dead SSO session silently 302-redirects to the login portal; both fetch and dart:io follow the redirect, so API calls return 200+text/html (or 200+JSON gateway error, or an empty event-stream) — sendProviderRequest in provider_common.dart rejects all three and emits the [[auth-expired:codemie]] marker. [#note,#source_agent,sso,harness]

project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. Budget arithmetic for GH Actions: attempts*max_time + (attempts-1)*sleep must fit the step's timeout-minutes (remember curl `--retry N` means N retries PLUS the initial attempt). project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. project: (note) Headless full-boot TUI tests (AgentCli with useTui: true) MUST pass `tuiProgramHooks: TuiProgramHooks(input: keys.stream, output: frames, width:, height:)` in AgentCliConfig — without it the dart_tui program writes to FakeCliIO's stdout and the _FrameSink stays empty forever, so every frames.text waitFor spins to timeout. Working twins: agent_hub_overlay_guard_test.dart, agent_cli_tui_sync_test.dart. Also anchor any injected waitingClock at DateTime.now(), never a pinned past date (overdue-timer storm starves the REPL loop). [#note,#source_agent,testing,tui,integration-test,gotcha]
project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. Budget arithmetic for GH Actions: attempts*max_time + (attempts-1)*sleep must fit the step's timeout-minutes (remember curl `--retry N` means N retries PLUS the initial attempt). [#note,#source_agent,ci,github-actions,curl,networking,workflows,gotcha]
project: (note) fa app-suite repair round (all under main checkout, ungated-clone-era debts): the flutter_app suite had 14 red tests+guards, ALL from other agents' hook-skipped commits — fixed in 0.1.239: (1) agent_service compaction-failure test expected 'transcript untouched' but the emergency _localTrimFallback (0.1.219, deliberate) honestly trims in-memory with a '[context trimmed locally…' marker while the session file keeps every record — test now asserts the marker + full records on disk; (2) session_chat_sheet drawer tests: FlutterSessionManager.openSession completes only over REAL async hops (widget-test fake clock doesn't advance it) — bounded drain loop `for(i<50 && activeId!=target) { await tester.runAsync(() => Future.delayed(10ms)); await pumpAndSettle(); }` after the tap; (3) map goldens: commit 4ea43d4e slimmed the bundle (map demo → fa_widgets catalog) — mapGolden + the controls-menu test now markTestSkipped when assets/apps/map/manifest.json is absent; (4) cli_visual ctrl+s test: shell-job ids are now sh-<n>-<uniq> — parse RegExp 'sh-[A-Za-z0-9-]+' from the /tasks screen and cancel the exact id (bare 'sh-1' → 'unknown job'); (5) cli_visual /agents inbox test: sessions live under <home>/Library/Group Containers/group.dev.fa1.shared/fa/sessions (macOS default, bin/fah.dart _defaultSessionRoot prefers it when writable) — seed mail by searching both roots; (6) session_reuse: aa770722 made corrupt JSONL lines QUARANTINED (dropped + .corrupt sidecar), not fatal — test updated to 'loads with junk quarantined'; (7) WidgetsCatalogSheet failed golden_guard (no golden) + l10n_guard ('Install failed: $error', 'Retry'×2 hardcoded) — added widgetsCatalogInstallFailed/Offline/LoadFailed/Retry keys (en+ru), context.l10n routing (import l10n_ext.dart!), new test/golden/widgets_catalog_golden_test.dart (MockClient catalog, pumpGolden+expectGolden, 420x700 in goldenSizeTall) registered in golden_guard _coverage; gen-l10n regenerates app_localizations*.dart.     # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:

project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. Budget arithmetic for GH Actions: attempts*max_time + (attempts-1)*sleep must fit the step's timeout-minutes (remember curl `--retry N` means N retries PLUS the initial attempt). project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. Budget arithmetic for GH Actions: attempts*max_time + (attempts-1)*sleep must fit the step's timeout-minutes (remember curl `--retry N` means N retries PLUS the initial attempt). project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. Budget arithmetic for GH Actions: attempts*max_time + (attempts-1)*sleep must fit the step's timeout-minutes (remember curl `--retry N` means N retries PLUS the initial attempt). Wait — there's a problem with the cancellation semantics for the legacy behavior. The OLD code:

```dart
while (_isDegenerateEmpty(current) && retries < config.maxEmptyRetries && !(cancelToken?.isCancelled ?? false))
```

Old: an empty + cancelled token → while doesn't run → return empty message → settle → exit 0 (silently). New: E5 conversion → aborted terminal. That's the intended E5 fix. But does any existing pinned test rely on cancel+empty returning the empty? Let me search later when running tests.

Also — the `StopReason.toolUse` case: a toolUse message with ONLY tool calls → `isEmptyAssistantCompletion` false (ToolCall) → notEmpty ✓. But hmm — WAIT. There's a subtle issue with `classifyEmptyCompletion` being called on EVERY turn in the while loop, including HEALTHY toolUse/text messages (the loop entry: current = the just-streamed message; verdict notEmpty → break immediately). That's an extra classification per turn — pure, cheap (window scan from the tail to the last user message). Fine.

But CAREFUL — a subtle bug: the `while (!cancelled)` loop entry runs classify on EVERY iteration INCLUDING the very first message which might be healthy — fine, breaks.

Another subtlety: the FIRST empty in a clean window with maxEmptyRetries=1 (app default): generic=0 <1 → generic++ → stream → empty again → generic=1 == max → classify: cleanEmpty → break ✓ (old behavior: retries(1) == max(1) → break) ✓.

And for a hiccup window with maxEmptyRetries=1 (app): empty → generic++ → stream → empty → generic==max → verdict emptyAfterPartial → hiccup=0 <3 → backoff → stream... → up to 3 hiccup retries → exhaustion error with attempts = 1 + 1 + 3 = 5. OK.

project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. Budget arithmetic for GH Actions: attempts*max_time + (attempts-1)*sleep must fit the step's timeout-minutes (remember curl `--retry N` means N retries PLUS the initial attempt). project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. Budget arithmetic for GH Actions: attempts*max_time + (attempts-1)*sleep must fit the step's timeout-minutes (remember curl `--retry N` means N retries PLUS the initial attempt). Wait — there's a problem with the cancellation semantics for the legacy behavior. The OLD code:

```dart
while (_isDegenerateEmpty(current) && retries < config.maxEmptyRetries && !(cancelToken?.isCancelled ?? false))
```

Old: an empty + cancelled token → while doesn't run → return empty message → settle → exit 0 (silently). New: E5 conversion → aborted terminal. That's the intended E5 fix. But does any existing pinned test rely on cancel+empty returning the empty? Let me search later when running tests.

Also — the `StopReason.toolUse` case: a toolUse message with ONLY tool calls → `isEmptyAssistantCompletion` false (ToolCall) → notEmpty ✓. But hmm — WAIT. There's a subtle issue with `classifyEmptyCompletion` being called on EVERY turn in the while loop, including HEALTHY toolUse/text messages (the loop entry: current = the just-streamed message; verdict notEmpty → break immediately). That's an extra classification per turn — pure, cheap (window scan from the tail to the last user message). Fine.

But CAREFUL — a subtle bug: the `while (!cancelled)` loop entry runs classify on EVERY iteration INCLUDING the very first message which might be healthy — fine, breaks.

Another subtlety: the FIRST empty in a clean window with maxEmptyRetries=1 (app default): generic=0 <1 → generic++ → stream → empty again → generic=1 == max → classify: cleanEmpty → break ✓ (old behavior: retries(1) == max(1) → break) ✓.

And for a hiccup window with maxEmptyRetries=1 (app): empty → generic++ → stream → empty → generic==max → verdict emptyAfterPartial → hiccup=0 <3 → backoff → stream... → up to 3 hiccup retries → exhaustion error with attempts = 1 + 1 + 3 = 5. OK.

project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. ```

Also — the `StopReason.toolUse` case: a toolUse message with ONLY tool calls → `isEmptyAssistantCompletion` false (ToolCall) → notEmpty ✓. But hmm — WAIT. There's a subtle issue with `classifyEmptyCompletion` being called on EVERY turn in the while loop, including HEALTHY toolUse/text messages (the loop entry: current = the just-streamed message; verdict notEmpty → break immediately). That's an extra classification per turn — pure, cheap (window scan from the tail to the last user message). Fine.

But CAREFUL — a subtle bug: the `while (!cancelled)` loop entry runs classify on EVERY iteration INCLUDING the very first message which might be healthy — fine, breaks.

Another subtlety: the FIRST empty in a clean window with maxEmptyRetries=1 (app default): generic=0 <1 → generic++ → stream → empty again → generic=1 == max → classify: cleanEmpty → break ✓ (old behavior: retries(1) == max(1) → break) ✓.

And for a hiccup window with maxEmptyRetries=1 (app): empty → generic++ → stream → empty → generic==max → verdict emptyAfterPartial → hiccup=0 <3 → backoff → stream... → up to 3 hiccup retries → exhaustion error with attempts = 1 + 1 + 3 = 5. OK.

project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. project: (note) curl's internal `--retry N` does NOT resume with `-C -`: on a timed-out attempt it starts over from offset 0, truncating the partial output (verified locally against a throttling range server — transfer restarted at 0 with `--retry 2 -C - --max-time 2`). To make a bounded, resumable download, own the retries in a bash loop and give curl only `-C - --max-time <budget>`; `rm -f` the partial file before the loop so `-C -` resumes only your own bytes. Wait — there's a problem with the cancellation semantics for the legacy behavior. The OLD code:

```dart
while (_isDegenerateEmpty(current) && retries < config.maxEmptyRetries && !(cancelToken?.isCancelled ?? false))
```

Old: an empty + cancelled token → while doesn't run → return empty message → settle → exit 0 (silently). New: E5 conversion → aborted terminal. That's the intended E5 fix. But does any existing pinned test rely on cancel+empty returning the empty? Let me search later when running tests.

Also — the `StopReason.toolUse` case: a toolUse message with ONLY tool calls → `isEmptyAssistantCompletion` false (ToolCall) → notEmpty ✓. But hmm — WAIT. There's a subtle issue with `classifyEmptyCompletion` being called on EVERY turn in the while loop, including HEALTHY toolUse/text messages (the loop entry: current = the just-streamed message; verdict notEmpty → break immediately). That's an extra classification per turn — pure, cheap (window scan from the tail to the last user message). Fine.

But CAREFUL — a subtle bug: the `while (!cancelled)` loop entry runs classify on EVERY iteration INCLUDING the very first message which might be healthy — fine, breaks.

Another subtlety: the FIRST empty in a clean window with maxEmptyRetries=1 (app default): generic=0 <1 → generic++ → stream → empty again → generic=1 == max → classify: cleanEmpty → break ✓ (old behavior: retries(1) == max(1) → break) ✓.

And for a hiccup window with maxEmptyRetries=1 (app): empty → generic++ → stream → empty → generic==max → verdict emptyAfterPartial → hiccup=0 <3 → backoff → stream... → up to 3 hiccup retries → exhaustion error with attempts = 1 + 1 + 3 = 5. OK.
